iommus_note.v: The ane node's iommu-parent is phandle 0x13b; dart-ane's own phandle is 0x13a and its one child is mapper-ane at unit address 0. The dump does not print mapper-ane's phandle: 0x13b is read as mapper-ane because it is the next phandle after dart-ane. Phandles change between boots.

segment_ranges_note.v: segment-ranges is four little-endian u64 per entry (phys, vmaddr, iova, size), named by segment-names. It is the layout of the image this boot loaded (build 26B5112a), read on one boot. It is not the layout of the image under firmware: ane/h15/ane_h15_fw_layout.h gives that image a TEXT size of 0xcc000.

compatible.reason: INFERENCE, not measured: no ANE mailbox node exists in the ADT summary (S1) or in the kernel tree (S4). Every other T8122 ASC mailbox in S4 (smc, aop, mtp, ans; t8122.dtsi:833-1069) is apple,t8122-asc-mailbox + apple,asc-mailbox-v4, so that class is expected. Detail: receipts/2026-10-03-ane-h15.

reg.reason: INFERENCE, not measured: no ADT window is named as the mailbox. On T6021 the ANE mailbox is the ASC wrapper + 0x8000 (engine + 0x1408000) and engine + 0x1050000 is RVBAR (ane/t6021/ane_t6021.h:104-147); every T8122 ASC mailbox in S4 is its ASC base + 0x8000. ANE reg[0] (S1) is engine + 0x1400000, so the expected mailbox is 0x311408000+0x4000, inside reg[0]. The earlier value 0x311050000 (reg[1], the T6021 RVBAR offset) had no source for the mailbox role.

interrupts.reason: INFERENCE, not measured: the ADT ane node lists 507 506 509 508 524 (S1, kept in ane.interrupts). The first four are the block 506..509; the last is the DART IRQ 525 minus one, as T6021's single ANE IRQ 884 is DART 885 minus one. Each T8122 ASC mailbox in S4 takes four consecutive lines named send-empty, send-not-empty, recv-empty, recv-not-empty in that order, which would make 506..509 the ANE mailbox in that order. The ADT does not name the roles. The earlier list 506, 508, 509, 507, 524 had no source.

ane_cpu_note.v: ANE_BASE is the sole ANE power-domain child and depends on ANE_TD and ANE_CPU.

driver_family.reason: INFERENCE (b0 decision, receipts/2026-10-03-ane-h15): ane_t6021-like at the ASC layer, no new ASC-IOP client. S1 gives reg[0] = engine + 0x1400000 (the ASC wrapper whose CPU_CONTROL ane_t6021 sets at +0x44), reg[1] = engine + 0x1050000 (the T6021 RVBAR offset) and the DART at engine + 0x1800000 with the T6021 four-window shape; S4 uses apple,asc-mailbox-v4 for every M3 ASC mailbox. Not measured: whether the firmware preloaded at boot on an M3 Linux system sends RTKit HELLO. The T6021 13.5 image never did, and its working path is the legacy ChMan ring, which is tied to that image.
